status: Additional regulator-input clamp candidate; assembly headroom remains unqualified
placement: U7 senses B at U4 VIN/GND. Its open-drain output shares BOOST_ENABLE with U6; retain U6 and the LTC depletion latch. MR and CT are open. Use the existing local C_U6 bypass beside both supervisors; effective capacitance, layout and loaded envelope remain undesigned. This adds one U7, not another assumed reservoir capacitor.

source_conditions.low_output: 1.5 V < VDD < 5 V and VDD < VIT-, 2 mA sink. Does not cover unknown ENABLE sources or every power-up state.
source_conditions.falling_delay: VDD transitions from VIT+ to VIT- minus 10%; slew below 100 mV/us; MR/CT open; output 100 kohm pull-up to VDD and 10 pF. These are test conditions, not established assembly values. The 30 us value is MAX; 15 us is typical.
source_conditions.startup: 350 us maximum startup with CT open does not prove no premature boost enable. Output is undefined below POR; the output-load-dependent POR conditions do not establish the complete module state.
source_conditions.availability: TPS3840DL35DBVR is listed as a released production part in the datasheet orderable addendum and active on the TI product page. Other possible threshold codes are not presumed released. No purchase requested.

reference_case.scope: Sensitivity calculation only: nominal 47 uF B reservoir, illustrative 10 milliohm total series path, 6.25 W/85% reference current at 2.9 V, zero extra boost shutdown time and zero inductive drop. These are not assembly bounds; the 47 uF excludes other capacitances and does not include tolerance. The calculation cannot establish real failure or success for the proposed circuit.

remaining_evidence: Minimum effective B capacitance, maximum ESR and both local conductors, load-step/inductive drops and all capacitor discharge paths for both designs
Coincident converter PWM/radio/inrush current plus bleeders/leakage/reverse escape; input eFuse current limit does not limit capacitor discharge current
Total ENABLE source current/capacitance, U6 interactions, actual VDD waveform/temperature and applicability of the supervisor timing test conditions
Maximum U4 delay from ENABLE low to load cessation; Pololu's true-shutdown description supplies no delay maximum
Startup ramps, retained rails, depleted-cell rebound and no cycling; U7 is an additional UVLO, not a depletion latch or reset proof
Backfeed/reversal, short-to-ground collapse and common-return faults need their own circuit-state bounds; a hold-up equation cannot protect a directly shorted input

supervisor.sections: 5 pins; 6.5 electrical limits; 6.6 timing and test conditions; 8.3 bypass; orderable addendum

boost.sections: Connections: at least 2.9 V input; ENABLE below 0.4 V; nominal 100 kohm pull-up. No shutdown-delay maximum or pull-up tolerance.
